rule.statement: When a plaintiff seeks a declaration of title to their main land and ejectment of an encroacher, they should describe their main land by reference to physical metes and bounds or a sufficient sketch, map, or plan, but not the encroached area.
rule.supporting_quote: What is expected by Section 41 of the Civil Procedure Code is to describe his main land by reference to physical metes and bounds or by reference to a sufficient sketch, map or plan but the said section does not expect to describe the encroached area in the plaint by reference to physical metes and bounds or by reference to a sufficient sketch, map or plan.
rule.statute_citation_verbatim: Section 41 of the Civil Procedure Code
